versions.short: The bill would allow the Secretary of the Interior, or the entity that runs a transferred federal water project, to carry out major repair and maintenance work on certain urban canals whose failure could put more than 100 people at risk, as determined by the Secretary under existing guidelines. For this work, the federal government would pay 25 percent of the total cost on a nonreimbursable basis, and would advance the remaining amount, which the operating entity would then repay. The bill would also make several technical changes to the definitions and wording of the Omnibus Public Land Management Act of 2009 to support this new authority.
